Hi Monica,

Hope you're well — attaching the latest Hall B floorplan (v4) with final sightlines. We've tentatively held Booth 312 (island, 20x20) in the corner by Aisle 7. Two quick items we need confirmed this week so we can finalize permits and freight slots:

- Hanging signage: the venue allows a max single-point load of 400 lbs and a maximum sign span of 25 ft. We need your final sign spec to raise the permit. See attached hanging_sign_specs_22ft.pdf.
- Freight / dock slots: load-in windows are 0700–1100 on move-in day. We can reserve two consecutive dock slots if you confirm crate count and dimensions.

Attachments: hallb_floorplan_v4.pdf, hanging_sign_specs_22ft.pdf (see page 2 for rigging notes).

If you can confirm the sign weight + the crate manifest by Friday (14th), I will book the slots and submit the hanging sign permit.

Hi Julia — thanks for the updated plan. A few confirmations from our side: 

1) Hanging sign: we plan a center-hung rectangular sign, 18 ft span, estimated assembled weight ~320 lbs (steel frame + printed fabric). Stephanie will attach the final artwork/specs by EOD Monday. Please confirm that a 320 lb single-point is acceptable under your 400 lb max and whether we need a separate engineering stamp for rigging.

2) Crates & freight: we will have 3 crates (two 8'x4'x5' and one 6'x3'x4'), all under 1,000 lbs each. Please reserve two adjacent dock slots on move-in morning; we anticipate needing forklift assistance at point of arrival. Full manifest attached: collateral_manifest_booth312.xlsx.

3) Power & AV: running 60 amps 208V (dedicated) and two floor boxes for AV. Let me know if we need to change placement on the floorplan.

Looping in Rishi for crate dimensions / outbound handling and Stephanie for artwork + hanging hardware callouts.

Best,
